== Source-supported English text states ==
The comparison records the original English face, the complete Decipher replacement wording, and the later PC Appendix A wording. Revised and Virtual editions remain in Versions. The original archived face prints the Dark Side Force icon; the Glossary and PC entries use the Light Side Force icon. The earlier audit description of the original icon is superseded.

Primary wording: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]], PDF page 64; [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 113. Edition dates identify the cited documents.
